name: IRLZ44N
source: International Rectifier (Infineon) IRLZ44NPbF データシート (PD-94831, 2003-11-11)
description: N チャネル パワーMOSFET 55V 47A (TO-220, ピン1=G 2=D 3=S)。ロジックレベル駆動 (4〜5V でオン)。データシート (IR) の代表特性から作った等価モデル (レベル1 + 直列抵抗)

transfer.at: 図 3 (伝達特性の代表特性、VDS = 25 V) の 25 °C

remarks: the PDF's text cannot be read out (its fonts carry no character codes): the table was read on the page drawn at 1.6 px/pt, and the graphs' axes were placed on the grid lines found with `ds grid` (thick: decades) and read with `ds trace` `xt=` / `yt=`
the table: VGS(th) min 1.0 / max 2.0 V (250 uA), RDS(on) max 22 / 25 / 35 mohm at 10 / 5 / 4 V; Ciss 1700, Coss 400, Crss 150 pF typ (VGS = 0, VDS = 25 V, 1 MHz)

rds: Figure 1 (25 C; the legend: 15, 12, 10, 8, 6, 4, 3, 2.5 V). At low VDS the curves from 6 to 15 V lie on each other (the top one, taken as 10 V: 9.07 A at 0.15 V, 30.5 A at 0.5 V); the next one is 4 V (6.76 A at 0.15 V, 21.07 A at 0.5 V)
transfer: Figure 3 (VDS = 25 V), the 25 C curve: below about 3 V the lower of the two, above it the upper
kept a .model without the body diode, as the part was bundled (the switching loss lesson's sample holds a copy; changing it to a .subckt would change the part's kind)
